lines.text: It’s project time! Generate a city skyline from procedures: a building procedure with a height parameter called in a loop with random arguments, plus at least one detail procedure.
Games like Minecraft generate worlds from procedures and random numbers.
building (height) draws a rectangle of a fixed width and the given height.
Add procedures for windows, roofs, trees or stars — each one small and tested.
List your procedures, their parameters and what each draws before you code.
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now plan it, build it, test it, and share it!
